---
name: Initiative
about: Plan a high-impact initiative with measurable outcomes and safe delivery controls
title: "[Initiative] "
labels: [initiative, governance]
assignees: ''
---

## Initiative summary
Describe the initiative in 2-4 sentences.

## Why now?
What strategic need, risk, or opportunity makes this urgent.

## Owner (required)
- Initiative owner:
- Engineering owner:
- Product owner:

## Scope and non-goals (required)
- In scope:
- Out of scope:

## Risk class (required)
Choose one: `A` (high), `B` (medium), `C` (low)

## Success metric (required)
Define one primary metric with a target and time window.

## Guardrail metrics (required)
List up to 3 metrics that must not regress.

## SLO impact (required)
Which user journey SLO(s) are affected and how.

## Rollout plan (required)
Describe environment path and release stages (cohort/percentage where applicable).

## Rollback plan (required)
Define exact trigger(s) and exact rollback action.

## Observability plan (required)
Events, traces, logs, dashboards, and alert thresholds to add/update.

## Test strategy (required)
Map key failure modes to tests (unit/integration/e2e/rules).

## Dependencies and sequencing
List technical/process dependencies and ordering constraints.

## Exit criteria (required)
What must be true to mark this initiative complete.
